get.description: Reports this process's health and contract revision.

stability.description: Registry stability of this key, when recorded at ingestion.

Common.Attribute.description: Key-value attribute pair following OTel conventions

Common.AttributeBytesValue.description: Base64 bytes projected by nami without colliding with an ordinary string attribute.

Common.AttributeDouble.description: An OTLP attribute double encoded as a JSON number when finite or a canonical named string when non-finite.

Common.AttributeInt64.description: An OTLP signed 64-bit attribute integer encoded without JavaScript precision loss.

Common.AttributeKeyValueListValue.description: Tagged recursive OTLP key-value-list, distinct from other object-shaped attribute variants.

Common.AttributeObjectValue.description: Object-shaped AttributeValue variants. The variant name is the wire `kind` tag.

Common.AttributeValue.description: Lossless JSON projection of an OpenTelemetry AnyValue attribute. Primitive variants are bare JSON values; object variants carry a `type` tag.

Common.ContractRevision.description: Deterministic revision of the generated API contract: 'sha256:' followed by all 64 hex characters of its canonical semantic digest.

Common.Cursor.description:
Opaque pagination cursor. Pass the `next_cursor` of one page to receive the
next page of the same query. Its content is not part of the contract and
must not be parsed or built by a client.

Common.DurationNs.description: Duration in nanoseconds, encoded as a decimal string

Common.EntityAttributeKey.description: A non-empty Resource attribute key referenced by an OpenTelemetry entity.

schema_url.description: Schema URL applying to the entity and its referenced Resource attributes, when known.

type.description: Stable non-empty entity type, such as service or host.

id_keys.description: Non-empty set of Resource attribute keys that identify the entity.

description_keys.description: Resource attribute keys that describe but do not identify the entity.

Common.EntityRef.description: A reference to an OpenTelemetry entity described by attributes on the containing Resource.

watermark.description: Ingest is complete through this instant for every signal read.

complete.description: True only when the requested window ends at or before the watermark.

examined.description: Records examined, or null when unknown.

matched.description: Matching records, or null when the read was cut short.

returned.description: Items returned, or null when unknown.

truncated.description: True when a row limit, page limit or byte budget omitted matching items.

Common.Freshness.description: Evidence completeness for the requested window. Unknown counts remain null.

name.description: Name of the instrumentation scope (library name)

schema_url.description: Scope schema URL supplied by the producer.

Common.InstrumentationScope.description: Instrumentation scope identifying the library/component emitting telemetry

Common.JsonInteger.description: A JSON integer exactly representable in both JavaScript and C#. Larger integers use decimal string encoding.

Common.MacAddress.description: MAC address in colon-separated hex notation

Common.OtlpFlags.description: The complete unsigned 32-bit OTLP flags field, including protocol bits unknown to this API revision.

Common.SessionId.description: Unique session identifier: URL-safe characters, at least one, at most 128, not only dots. The same rule the SDK enforces on the baggage header.

Common.SnapshotId.description: Opaque, project-scoped identity of an immutable telemetry snapshot.

Common.SpanId.description: Unique span identifier (16 lowercase hex characters)

Common.TimeSpec.description: Absolute RFC 3339 instant or a negative relative duration such as -15m, -2h, -7d or -30s.

Common.Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp preserved exactly as text, including fractional precision and offset. Leap seconds are not supported. Execution windows additionally require an instant representable by the telemetry store.

Common.ToolError.description: A typed tool refusal. The field and allowed values make invalid arguments repairable.

service.description: Filter by the producer's service.name resource attribute.

since.description: Inclusive window start; defaults to one hour before the snapshot's observation time.

fields.description: Requested fields. Unknown fields are refused with the allowed field names.

max_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes in structuredContent, from 1024 to 262144.

snapshot_id.description: Reuse a snapshot returned by an earlier call for byte-identical reads.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding page; keep all other arguments unchanged.

Common.ToolReadInput.description: Arguments shared by every read-only tool.

Common.ToolResult.description: Evidence metadata returned with every successful tool result.

Common.TraceId.description: Unique trace identifier (32 lowercase hex characters)

Common.TraceParent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header format

Common.TraceState.description: W3C Trace Context tracestate header (vendor-specific key-value pairs)

Common.UnixNanos.description: Unsigned Unix timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch, encoded as a decimal string

contract_revision.description: Revision of the API contract this process serves; a client compares it with the revision it was generated from.

Health.HealthReport.description: Readiness or liveness report returned by /health and /alive.

Health.HealthStatus.description: Health state reported by a nami-managed process.

OTel.Enums.SeverityNumber.description: Log severity number following OTel specification (1-24)

OTel.Enums.SpanKind.description: Span kind describing the relationship between spans

time_unix_nano.description: Timestamp when the event occurred (nanoseconds since epoch). Absent when the source timestamp is unknown; use observed_time_unix_nano as the display fallback when present.

observed_time_unix_nano.description: Timestamp when the log was observed/collected (nanoseconds since epoch). Absent when a historical record did not capture it.

severity_text.description: Severity text exactly as supplied by the producer; classification uses severity_number.

body.description: Log body: the OTLP AnyValue, projected exactly like an attribute value

event_name.description: Optional event category whose presence identifies this log record as an event; records with the same name are expected to share one body and attribute schema.

resource.description: Resource describing the entity that produced this log

OTel.Metrics.MetricCount.description: An unsigned OTLP count encoded as a decimal string to preserve all 64 bits.

OTel.Metrics.MetricExemplar.description: One original metric exemplar, in producer order.

OTel.Metrics.MetricExponentialBuckets.description: Native exponential-histogram buckets. Each count corresponds to offset plus its array index.

OTel.Metrics.MetricExponentialHistogramP.description: An original exponential histogram. Its native scale and buckets are never reconstructed from explicit bounds.

OTel.Metrics.MetricHistogramPointData.description: An original explicit histogram, before any query projection or interpolation.

OTel.Metrics.MetricNumberPointData.description: The numeric oneof of a gauge or sum point.

OTel.Metrics.MetricNumberValue.description: A numeric OTLP value. Integers preserve all signed 64 bits; doubles retain named non-finite values.

OTel.Metrics.MetricPointData.description: The original typed OTLP point data, independent of the collector's derived aggregate columns.

OTel.Metrics.MetricQuantileValue.description: An original summary quantile and its producer-supplied estimate.

OTel.Metrics.MetricSummaryPointData.description: An original OTLP summary. Query reducers must explicitly support summaries rather than invent histogram buckets.

service_name.description: Service name used by the Collector's service queries.

attributes.description: Resource attributes, including service, deployment, host, cloud and process metadata.

schema_url.description: Resource schema URL supplied by the producer.

dropped_attributes_count.description: Number of resource attributes dropped by the producer.

entity_refs.description: Entities participating in this resource, keyed by its attributes.

OTel.Resource.Resource.description: The telemetry producer and its resource attributes. Attribute names and values follow the producer's semantic-convention schema; the API does not duplicate that vocabulary.

parent_span_id.description: Parent span identifier (null for root spans)

start_time_unix_nano.description: Start timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch

end_time_unix_nano.description: End timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch

resource.description: Resource describing the entity that produced this span

OTel.Traces.Span.description: OpenTelemetry Span representing a single operation in a distributed trace

time_unix_nano.description: Event timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch

OTel.Traces.SpanEvent.description: Event occurring during a span's lifetime

trace_state.description: Trace state of the linked span

OTel.Traces.SpanLink.description: Link to another span (e.g., batch processing)

OTel.Traces.Trace.description: Complete trace containing all related spans

OTel.Traces.TraceSummary.description: Trace summary without the full span collection

Tools.Change.description: A resource attribute transition observed on ingestion.

Tools.ChangesRecentInput.description: Resource changes recorded in telemetry, without querying a deployment service.

Tools.ChangesRecentResult.description: Observed revision, version, environment and pipeline changes.

Tools.ErrorGroup.description: A deduplicated error group and one correlated example when available.

Tools.ErrorsRecentInput.description: Recent errors grouped by error type and operation, without stack traces.

Tools.ErrorsRecentResult.description: Groups of errors from log events, span events and error-status spans.

Tools.LogHit.description: A matching log with optional trace correlation.

Tools.LogsSearchInput.description: Find log bodies containing literal, case-sensitive text; this is not a regular expression.

Tools.LogsSearchResult.description: Log records containing the literal query.

Tools.ProjectedChange.description: A field projection of Change; omitted members were not requested.

Tools.ProjectedErrorGroup.description: A field projection of ErrorGroup; omitted members were not requested.

Tools.ProjectedLogHit.description: A field projection of LogHit; omitted members were not requested.

Tools.ProjectedSlowTrace.description: A field projection of SlowTrace; omitted members were not requested.

Tools.ProjectedSourceStatus.description: A field projection of SourceStatus; omitted members were not requested.

Tools.ProjectedTrace.description: A projected trace. An omitted field was not requested; it is not a fabricated value.

Tools.SignalStatus.description: The latest receipt time for one signal, or how long it has been silent.

Tools.SlowTrace.description: One trace in a duration ranking.

Tools.SourcesStatusInput.description: The health of telemetry sources, including silent signals.

Tools.TracesGetInput.description: Read one trace, projecting only requested fields.

Tools.TracesGetResult.description: The requested trace and evidence completeness.

Tools.TracesSlowestInput.description: The slowest traces in the selected window.
